main.title: Promptly
main.subtitle: The fastest, most reliable, and context-specific tool for drafting critical professional and personal emails.
main.scenario_select_subtitle: Start by choosing a template for your email.

error_toast.title: Error
error_toast.description: Failed to generate draft. Please try again.

how_it_works.title: How It Works
how_it_works.step1_description: Select from a wide range of professional templates like cover letters, salary negotiations, or project updates.
how_it_works.step2_description: Fill in a few key details to personalize the email draft for your specific needs.
how_it_works.step3_description: Receive a perfectly formatted and professional email draft in seconds. Copy and use it anywhere.
